sentences.zh: 但对很多人来说，今年的美网不在于谁赢了。

sentences.en: It was about a player who wasn't even on the court last week, Serena WilliaMs. Today, my colleague Natalie Ketroev speaks with New York Times culture critic
sentences.zh: 而在于一个上周甚至没有出现在球场上的球员——小威廉姆斯。今天，我的同事娜塔莉·凯特罗耶夫采访了《纽约时报》文化评论员

sentences.en: Wesley Morris on the tennis great's retirement and on her impact on tennis, sports, and the country.
sentences.zh: 韦斯利·莫里斯，讨论这位网球巨星的退役以及她对网球、体育和这个国家的影响。

sentences.en: It's Monday, September 12th.
sentences.zh: 今天是 9 月 12 日，星期一。

sentences.en: Hi, Wesley.
sentences.zh: 嗨，韦斯利。

sentences.en: Welcome back.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回来。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: Natalie, hi.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，嗨。

sentences.en: Okay, so I want to start with a disclosure, some real talk.
sentences.zh: 好的，我想先做个声明，说点掏心窝子的话。

sentences.en: What's talk?
sentences.zh: 什么话？

sentences.en: Which is that a little bit ago, we taped an entirely different episode about Serena Williams, who announced last month that she would be retiring from professional tennis.
sentences.zh: 就是不久前，我们录制了一期完全不同的节目，主角是小威廉姆斯，她上个月宣布将退役，告别职业网球生涯。

sentences.en: And we made said episode anticipating that she would be out after the first round of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们录制这期节目时，预计她在美国网球公开赛

sentences.en: Open because you, Wesley, two-time Pulitzer Prize-winning culture critic and lifelong tennis fan, you were absolutely certain of it.
sentences.zh: 第一轮后就会出局，因为你，韦斯利，这位两届普利策奖文化评论员兼终身网球迷，对此深信不疑。

sentences.en: I mean, look, yes, I did think that in round one of the 2022 U.S.
sentences.zh: 我是说，听着，是的，我确实认为在 2022 年美网的第一轮比赛中，

sentences.en: Open, her very last professional tennis tournament, I thought she was going to lose.
sentences.zh: 在她职业生涯的最后一场网球锦标赛里，我以为她会输。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But then she went on this run.
sentences.zh: 但后来她打出了一波高潮。

sentences.en: Not a long run, but not a tiny one either.
sentences.zh: 不是那种很长的连胜，但也不算短。

sentences.en: And we're going to get to that.
sentences.zh: 我们一会儿就会聊到这个。

sentences.en: But the crazy thing about it, about how we blew it, is that that's the idea behind this episode.
sentences.zh: 但最疯狂的是，关于我们是怎么搞砸的，这正是本期节目的核心所在。

sentences.en: It's how Serena Williams always seems to defy expectations.
sentences.zh: 那就是小威廉姆斯总是能打破人们的预期。

sentences.en: I just sort of feel like nothing about Serena is predictable.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得关于小威的一切都是不可预测的。

sentences.en: We don't really even know where to begin with what she has come to mean, along with her sister Venus, to professional tennis.
sentences.zh: 对于她和姐姐大威廉姆斯对职业网球意味着什么，我们甚至不知道该从何说起。

sentences.en: One of the things that comes up in this question of what Serena Williams is, means, is this idea of the GOAT, the greatest of all time.
sentences.zh: 探讨小威廉姆斯是谁、意味着什么时，绕不开的一个概念就是 GOAT，史上最佳。

sentences.en: And this is a conversation that everybody likes to have.
sentences.zh: 这是一个每个人都乐于谈论的话题。

sentences.en: I think that it goes like this, Natalie.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它是这样的，娜塔莉。

sentences.en: Muhammad Ali, Serena WilliaMs.
sentences.zh: 穆罕默德·阿里，小威廉姆斯。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Like, Muhammad Ali is the greatest athlete of all time, period.
sentences.zh: 比如，穆罕默德·阿里就是有史以来最伟大的运动员，句号。

sentences.en: He just is.
sentences.zh: 他就是当之无愧。

sentences.en: Not only for what he did in the sport, because I think greatness, it has to be something about what you risked, what you signified, what you changed, how you changed your sport.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是因为他在体育运动中所做的事，因为我认为伟大必须包含你所承担的风险、你所代表的意义、你所改变的东西，以及你如何改变了你的运动项目。

sentences.en: I think Serena Williams' effect on tennis and on people's perception of what the sport is and what it could be, especially
sentences.zh: 我认为小威廉姆斯对网球以及人们对这项运动是什么、能够成为什么的看法所产生的影响，尤其是

sentences.en: for Black people, for non-white people, for poor people, for people all over the world who thought tennis was an elitist sport.
sentences.zh: 对黑人、非白人、穷人，以及全世界所有认为网球是精英运动的人来说。

sentences.en: We're just, we're years away from us even beginning to understand this woman's significance.
sentences.zh: 我们还需要很多年，才能真正开始理解这个女性的伟大意义。

sentences.en: Okay, so let's start getting to the bottom of that, to the bottom of her significance.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我们开始深入探讨这一点，探究她的伟大意义所在。

sentences.en: Where should we start?
sentences.zh: 我们该从哪里开始呢？

sentences.en: Compton, California, baby!
sentences.zh: 加利福尼亚州康普顿，宝贝！

sentences.en: Venus and Serena grew up in Compton, California.
sentences.zh: 大威和小威是在加利福尼亚州康普顿长大的。

sentences.en: And they're the daughters of Orsene Price,
sentences.zh: 她们是奥森·普莱斯、

sentences.en: Richard WilliaMs.
sentences.zh: 理查德·威廉姆斯的女儿。

sentences.en: You got to win.
sentences.zh: 你必须赢。

sentences.en: No, you're going to win.
sentences.zh: 不，你会赢的。

sentences.en: You're going to win for us?
sentences.zh: 你会为我们赢得比赛吗？

sentences.en: Good girl.
sentences.zh: 好女孩。

sentences.en: And one day, Richard's watching TV.
sentences.zh: 有一天，理查德在看电视。

sentences.en: And they was giving this young lady $40,000 because she won the tournament.
sentences.zh: 电视里正在给一位年轻女士颁发 4 万美元的奖金，因为她赢得了比赛。

sentences.en: And I figured since I worked for $52,000 all year, and this girl makes $40,000 in four days, I knew I was in the wrong business.
sentences.zh: 我想既然我整年辛辛苦苦也才赚 52,000 美元，而这个女孩在四天内就能赚 40,000 美元，我知道我入错了行。

sentences.en: And he's like, oh man, this might be a thing my children can do.
sentences.zh: 于是他想，天哪，这也许是我孩子也能做的事。

sentences.en: We didn't talk on the phone.
sentences.zh: 我们不怎么通电话。

sentences.en: We didn't go to school parties.
sentences.zh: 我们不参加学校派对。

sentences.en: And most of the time I was at practice.
sentences.zh: 大多数时间我都在训练。

sentences.en: And so he takes Venus and Serena to public courts every day, day in, day out.
sentences.zh: 于是他每天都带着大威和小威去公共球场，日复一日。

sentences.en: And they practice and practice and practice.
sentences.zh: 她们不停地练习、练习、再练习。

sentences.en: And you know, from the beginning, from the beginning, Richard knew what he had.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，从一开始，理查德就知道自己手里握着什么王牌。

sentences.en: Every champion that Leo has four main qualities, and she has all those qualities.
sentences.zh: 列奥的每个冠军都有四个主要特质，而她具备所有这些特质。

sentences.en: And that's what makes Venus Venus.
sentences.zh: 这就是大威之所以成为大威的原因。

sentences.en: And Serena, she's so strong.
sentences.zh: 至于小威，她太强了。

sentences.en: Serena would probably be a better player than Venus.
sentences.zh: 小威可能会成为比大威更优秀的球员。

sentences.en: That's not to compare my girls, but she will be.
sentences.zh: 这不是在比较我的女儿们，但事实确实如此。

sentences.en: And he was telling anybody who would listen, you know, my wife and I, we train these two girls, and they're going to spank your daughters.
sentences.zh: 他会向任何愿意倾听的人说，你知道的，我和我妻子在训练这两个女孩，她们会狠狠修理你们的女儿。

sentences.en: Look out.
sentences.zh: 当心点。

sentences.en: I got two Chanice Champions in my house.
sentences.zh: 我家里有两个网球冠军。

sentences.en: So yes, I think sometime about them winning the big ones like the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以是的，我想有时候关于她们赢得像美网

sentences.en: Open and the
sentences.zh: 和温网这样的大赛，

sentences.en: Wimbledon, and we will win them one day.
sentences.zh: 我们终有一天会赢下它们。

sentences.en: So I have to imagine there was this disbelief, right, that these two black sisters from Compton were going to be as good as their dad promised.
sentences.zh: 所以我可以想象当时一定有人不相信，对吧，不相信这两个来自康普顿的黑人姐妹能像她们父亲承诺的那样优秀。

sentences.en: — Natalie, I didn't believe it.
sentences.zh: ——娜塔莉，我当时也不相信。

sentences.en: Because you have to remember that the sport they were entering was, it was a white sport.
sentences.zh: 因为你必须记住，她们进入的这项运动，是一项白人的运动。

sentences.en: And it wasn't as though this predominantly white sport had never had black players before.
sentences.zh: 并不是说这项由白人为主导的运动以前从来没有过黑人球员。

sentences.en: There was Althea Gibson, the great Althea Gibson, who was the country's first black woman to win Wimbledon, among other tournaments.
sentences.zh: 曾有阿尔西娅·吉布森，伟大的阿尔西娅·吉布森，她是美国第一位赢得温布尔登网球锦标赛以及其他赛事的黑人女性。

sentences.en: There was Arthur Ashe, who faced his own sort of uphill battle to win the majors that he won.
sentences.zh: 还有亚瑟·阿什，他在赢得自己的大满贯时也面临着属于他自己的艰难险阻。

sentences.en: Those players made an impact on the sport, but they didn't change the sport, right?
sentences.zh: 这些球员对这项运动产生了影响，但他们并没有改变这项运动，对吧？

sentences.en: They succeeded.
sentences.zh: 他们成功了。

sentences.en: They went to finals in a lot of cases.
sentences.zh: 在很多情况下他们都打进了决赛。

sentences.en: They had great memorable matches.
sentences.zh: 他们有过精彩难忘的比赛。

sentences.en: But it was still a white sport predominantly.
sentences.zh: 但它主要依然是一项白人的运动。

sentences.en: And it didn't seem possible that somebody could come along and assert their blackness into this sport, like Venus and Serena.
sentences.zh: 而且似乎不可能有人能像大威和小威那样，将她们的黑人身份强势融入这项运动中。

sentences.en: And so I would say what
sentences.zh: 所以我要说的是，

sentences.en: Venus and Serena are entering is a sport that has always conceived of itself as being a white sport, even if they wouldn't say that it was a white sport.
sentences.zh: 大威和小威进入的是一项一直自视为白人运动的体育项目，哪怕他们不会明说这是一项白人运动。

sentences.en: You know, anybody could look at it and be like, well, who's not playing the sport?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，任何人看一眼都能明白，究竟是谁没有在打这项运动？

sentences.en: And when they get there, then it becomes a matter of all of the things that tennis has always been versus everything these two people represent.
sentences.zh: 当她们到达那里时，这就变成了一场较量：网球一直以来所代表的一切，对阵这两个人所代表的一切。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: What happens when the Williams sisters arrive on the tour?
sentences.zh: 当威廉姆斯姐妹登上巡回赛时，发生了什么？

sentences.en: So Venus was the first to go professional.
sentences.zh: 大威是第一个转为职业球员的。

sentences.en: And I think she won her first match when she was 14.
sentences.zh: 我想她在 14 岁时就赢得了她的第一场比赛。

sentences.en: And Serena waited a little longer to get onto the circuit.
sentences.zh: 而小威稍微晚了一点才进入巡回赛。

sentences.en: But by about 16, I mean, she was beating some of the top players in the world.
sentences.zh: 但到 16 岁左右时，我的意思是，她已经开始击败世界上一些顶级球员了。

sentences.en: And once they start winning, people have to start taking what Richard said seriously about him having these great tennis player daughters that he wasn't playing, essentially.
sentences.zh: 一旦她们开始赢球，人们就不得不开始认真对待理查德的话，即他拥有这些伟大的网球手女儿，而且他绝不是在开玩笑。

sentences.en: It was the truth.
sentences.zh: 这是真的。

sentences.en: And before long, they become so dominant that they're playing each other in championships.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，她们变得如此具有统治力，以至于在锦标赛中狭路相逢。

sentences.en: And it's so unusual for this to happen.
sentences.zh: 这种情况发生是非常罕见的。

sentences.en: This family basically said this was going to happen, that these two people were going to be playing a lot of tennis at a major level.
sentences.zh: 这个家庭基本上早就预言了这一切的发生，这两个人将在重大赛事中进行大量高水平的网球对决。

sentences.en: And it was coming true.
sentences.zh: 而这一切正在变成现实。

sentences.en: And at the point at which it becomes clear that watching Venus and
sentences.zh: 当情况变得明朗——即看着大威和

sentences.en: Serena play each other in championship semifinals and finals was just going to be a regular staple of the American tennis watching diet, this really wild thing happens.
sentences.zh: 小威在锦标赛的半决赛和决赛中互相交手，将成为美国网球观众的家常便饭时，一件非常疯狂的事情发生了。

sentences.en: The whole sport just kind of starts to go into denial.
sentences.zh: 整个网球界开始陷入某种程度的否认。

sentences.en: There were years in which people thought they were actually fixing the matches.
sentences.zh: 曾有那么几年，人们甚至认为她们在打假球。

sentences.en: Cheating!
sentences.zh: 作弊！

sentences.en: That somehow Richard had said, okay, Venus, you're going to win this match.
sentences.zh: 认为理查德不知怎么地下了命令，说，好吧，大威，这场比赛你赢。

sentences.en: And
sentences.zh: 而

sentences.en: Serena, you're just going to have to, you know, just like pretend to try your beSt. But ultimately, it's Venus's turn.
sentences.zh: 小威，你只要，你知道的，就像是假装尽力而为就行了。但归根结底，这次轮到大威赢。

sentences.en: She's going to win.
sentences.zh: 她会获胜。

sentences.en: People thought this.
sentences.zh: 人们就是这么想的。

sentences.en: People thought that he was pulling the strings to make sure that when they played each other, the Williams family would get the outcome it wanted.
sentences.zh: 人们认为他在幕后操控一切，以确保当她们交手时，威廉姆斯家族能得到想要的结果。

sentences.en: That we weren't watching professional tennis, we're watching professional wrestling.
sentences.zh: 我们看的不是职业网球，而是在看职业摔角。

sentences.en: Okay, where do we see this playing out on the court?
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们在球场的什么地方能看到这种现象上演？

sentences.en: The first incident that comes to mind, the most notorious incident that comes to mind is the tournament at Indian Wells in California in 2001.
sentences.zh: 我脑海中浮现的第一起事件，也是最臭名昭著的一起事件，是 2001 年在加利福尼亚州印第安维尔斯的锦标赛。

sentences.en: Welcome to viewers from British Eurosport.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收看英国欧洲体育频道的观众朋友。

sentences.en: It's an amazing sound here.
sentences.zh: 这里的欢呼声太惊人了。

sentences.en: Venus was supposed to play Serena in the semifinal, but Venus pulled out right before the match because she had an injury.
sentences.zh: 大威本应在半决赛中对阵小威，但大威在赛前因伤退赛了。

sentences.en: And so Serena basically gets a walkover to the final against Kim Clijsters.
sentences.zh: 因此小威基本上是不战而胜，直接晋级决赛对阵金·克里斯特尔斯。

sentences.en: And there's just this uproar.
sentences.zh: 然后现场就爆发了轩然大波。

sentences.en: Like, everybody was upset being like, Richard fixed this so they wouldn't have to play each other.
sentences.zh: 每个人都很愤怒，认为这是理查德安排的，好让她们不必互相厮杀。

sentences.en: So that Serena would basically just get to go straight to the final.
sentences.zh: 这样小威基本上就能直接晋级决赛了。

sentences.en: And there's Father Richard coming down.
sentences.zh: 看呐，父亲理查德走下来了。

sentences.en: It's quite amazing.
sentences.zh: 这太惊人了。

sentences.en: There's Venus.
sentences.zh: 大威也在。

sentences.en: And the crowd, an American crowd, booing an American family.
sentences.zh: 看台上，一群美国观众在嘘一个美国家庭。

sentences.en: Venus and Richard, you know, entering the stadium to get to their seats.
sentences.zh: 大威和理查德，你知道的，正走进体育馆去他们的座位。

sentences.en: They're walking down.
sentences.zh: 他们正在走下来。

sentences.en: And you just hear the sound of boos.
sentences.zh: 你只能听到一片嘘声。

sentences.en: Well, I'm just speechless.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我简直无言以对。

sentences.en: I've never heard this before ever.
sentences.zh: 我以前从未听过这样的声音，绝对没有。

sentences.en: And I've been on the circuit or was on the circuit for quite a long time.
sentences.zh: 我在巡回赛里待过，或者说在巡回赛里待了相当长的一段时间。

sentences.en: It's just, it's like you would think it was Roman times.
sentences.zh: 这简直就像是回到了古罗马时期。

sentences.en: It's just jeering, constant, loud, jeering.

sentences.en: So, this scene kind of reminds me of that incident that we talked about at the Indian Wells Tournament.

sentences.en: Yes!
sentences.zh: 没错！

sentences.en: Yes!
sentences.zh: 没错！

sentences.en: Serena, by now, she's a different player.
sentences.zh: 塞雷娜，到如今，她已经是一名完全不同的球员了。

sentences.en: She's won so many titles.
sentences.zh: 她赢得了如此多的冠军。

sentences.en: But she's still being accused of cheating, of not respecting the game.
sentences.zh: 但她仍然被指责作弊，指责她不尊重这项运动。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.

sentences.en: And this whole incident, to me, Natalie, just reminds me of this Vogue essay that she wrote,
sentences.zh: 而整起事件，娜塔莉，对我而言，只是让我想起了她写的一篇《Vogue》文章，

sentences.en: where she announced, among other things, her retirement earlier this summer, in advance of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 她在文中宣布了其他事情，包括今年夏天早些时候、在美网开赛前退役的决定。

sentences.en: Open.
sentences.zh: 网球公开赛。

sentences.en: And, Natalie, would you allow me to read a little bit from that, please?
sentences.zh: 而且，娜塔莉，你能允许我读一点其中的内容吗？

sentences.en: Please do.
sentences.zh: 请读吧。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Unlike Venus, who's always been stoic and classy, I've never been one to contain my emotions.
sentences.zh: 与维纳斯不同，她一直沉着优雅，而我从来都不是一个能掩饰自己情绪的人。

sentences.en: I remember learning to write my alphabet for kindergarten and not doing it perfectly and crying all night.
sentences.zh: 我记得上幼儿园时学写字母，写得不够完美，结果哭了一整夜。

sentences.en: Mm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I was so angry about it.
sentences.zh: 我为此感到非常生气。

sentences.en: I'd erase and rewrite that A over and over.
sentences.zh: 我一遍又一遍地擦掉并重写那个字母A。

sentences.en: And my mother let me stay up all night while my sisters were in bed.
sentences.zh: 我母亲让我熬夜到天亮，而我的姐姐妹妹们早就上床睡觉了。

sentences.en: That's always been me.
sentences.zh: 我一直都是这样。

sentences.en: I want to be great.
sentences.zh: 我想要变得伟大。

sentences.en: I want to be perfect.
sentences.zh: 我想要做到完美。

sentences.en: I know perfect doesn't exiSt.
sentences.zh: 我知道这世上本就没有完美。

sentences.en: But whatever my perfect was, I never wanted to stop until I got it right.
sentences.zh: 但无论我心中的完美是什么样，在做好之前我都绝不想停下来。

sentences.en: And I think the thing that is so exasperating for her is that she, once again, is trying to respect the game.
sentences.zh: 我想，最让她感到气恼的是，她再一次试图去尊重这项运动。

sentences.en: And the idea that you're accusing me of disrespecting the game is just so dishonoring to me.
sentences.zh: 而你指责我不尊重这项运动的想法，对我是极大的侮辱。

sentences.en: Because all I'm trying to do is get my cursive right.
sentences.zh: 因为我所做的一切只是想把草书写好。

sentences.en: And I can't do it.
sentences.zh: 而我却做不到。

sentences.en: She's trying to figure out a way to win by herself.
sentences.zh: 她正试图寻找一种靠自己赢得比赛的方法。

sentences.en: And this guy, this umpire, who's got his own honor agenda, is just, like, accusing her of doing the opposite.
sentences.zh: 而这个家伙，这个裁判，带着他自己的一套荣誉标准，却指责她做了相反的事情。

sentences.en: And wherever she was on that court that day had to involve Indian Wells in 2001 to me.
sentences.zh: 对我而言，那天她在球场上的任何地方，都必然会让人联想到2001年的印第安维尔斯。

sentences.en: It had to involve all the times that she has heard that people have been skeptical about all the other times that she had to play her sister.
sentences.zh: 这必然会让人想起她经历过的所有质疑，以及人们对她不得不与姐姐对决的种种怀疑。

sentences.en: Okay, Wesley, I think it's finally time to talk about this last Serena Williams U.S.
sentences.zh: 好了，韦斯利，我觉得是时候聊聊塞雷娜·威廉姆斯最后一次美网征程了。

sentences.en: Open run.
sentences.zh: 公开赛。

sentences.en: Oh my god!
sentences.zh: 天哪！

sentences.en: Sports, man!
sentences.zh: 这就是体育，老兄！

sentences.en: Sports!
sentences.zh: 体育啊！

sentences.en: There is something alchemical, psychological, historical, personal.
sentences.zh: 这里面有着某种炼金术般的、心理上的、历史的和个人的因素。

sentences.en: There's a lot of deep stuff happening when you are about to basically change your life.
sentences.zh: 当你即将彻底改变你的人生时，背后有很多深层的东西在发生。

sentences.en: And not just privately change your life, like you're going to pack up your desk, carry your stuff home, and then just never go back to that job.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅仅是私下里改变人生，比如你收拾好办公桌，把东西拿回家，然后就再也不去那份工作了。

sentences.en: You are packing your desk up in, like, front of millions of people.
sentences.zh: 你是在数百万人的注视下收拾办公桌。

sentences.en: Millions of people who have paid a lot of money to see you put your stapler in a box.
sentences.zh: 数百万花了大笔钱来看你把订书机放进盒子里的观众。

sentences.en: And I don't know what that experience is like, but I definitely thought that she was going to pack up the box in one round.
sentences.zh: 我不知道那是一种什么体验，但我绝对以为她会在第一轮就收拾包袱走人。

sentences.en: Right, right.
sentences.zh: 没错，没错。

sentences.en: That she was going to lose at the very beginning of this tournament.
sentences.zh: 以为她会在这次比赛的最开始就输掉。

sentences.en: Yeah, she's going to be dumping drawers out in the first round and, like, going to her car in the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 对，她会在第一轮就狼狈地清空抽屉，然后去停车场找她的车。

sentences.en: And she plays her first round match.
sentences.zh: 然后她进行了她的第一轮比赛。

sentences.en: And to everybody's great excitement, she wins her first round match.
sentences.zh: 在所有人极大的兴奋中，她赢下了第一轮比赛。

sentences.en: I'm just ready, and I'm just Serena, and I'm here just being the best that I can.
sentences.zh: 我只管准备好，我就是塞雷娜，我来到这里只为了展现最好的自己。

sentences.en: I mean, I think that we were all prepared to just be satisfied with the one match.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我想我们当时都觉得只要赢了一场就心满意足了。

sentences.en: The one match was enough.
sentences.zh: 赢一场就足够了。

sentences.en: I don't know about you, Natalie, but I was a believer.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你怎么想，娜塔莉，但我当时是个坚定的信徒。

sentences.en: And then, in the second round, she won again!
sentences.zh: 然后，在第二轮中，她又赢了！

sentences.en: And there was something about watching her play, especially that third round match that she loSt.
sentences.zh: 看着她打球，尤其是她输掉的那场第三轮比赛，有一种说不出的感觉。

sentences.en: Where she was fighting, what, like, five match points?
sentences.zh: 她当时在化解什么，大概五个赛点吧？

sentences.en: Like, basically almost losing point after point.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是接连不断地濒临输掉比赛。

sentences.en: But just finding a way to stay in that tennis match longer than she probably should have.
sentences.zh: 但她就是找到了方法，在那个网球场上坚持得比她本该坚持的时间更久。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I've never seen anybody fight the way she fights.
sentences.zh: 我从未见过任何人像她那样去战斗。

sentences.en: And we were all, everybody, everybody.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人，每个人，每一个人。

sentences.en: I walked on my way home to watch the match.
sentences.zh: 我在回家的路上都在看这场比赛。

sentences.en: Every TV I passed had the match on.
sentences.zh: 我路过的每一台电视机都在播放这场比赛。

sentences.en: I was like, ah!
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，啊！

sentences.en: But people were watching it.
sentences.zh: 人们都在看。

sentences.en: We were all glued to this story in some way.
sentences.zh: 我们都以某种方式被这个故事深深吸引了。

sentences.en: Many, many, many of us.
sentences.zh: 我们当中的许许多多人。

sentences.en: Because we didn't want it to end.
sentences.zh: 因为我们不想让它结束。

sentences.en: Because I think the announcement, her announcement that she was retiring,
sentences.zh: 因为我认为这个声明，她宣布自己即将退役的声明，

sentences.en: it meant that we were going to have to say goodbye to something I don't think we fully appreciated while we had it.
sentences.zh: 意味着我们要向某种我们曾经拥有却未能充分珍惜的事物告别。

sentences.en: Serena!
sentences.zh: 塞雷娜！

sentences.en: Okay, unpack that for me.
sentences.zh: 好吧，帮我剖析一下这个。

sentences.en: Serena and Venus WilliaMs.
sentences.zh: 塞雷娜和维纳斯·威廉姆斯。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It wasn't all the other players.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是其他所有球员。

sentences.en: It was these two people who invited them to watch this sport.
sentences.zh: 正是这两个人把人们带入了这项运动的观众席。

sentences.en: And made them understand how it's played.
sentences.zh: 并让人明白了它是如何被游玩的。

sentences.en: How to keep the score.
sentences.zh: 如何记分。

sentences.en: What the strokes were.
sentences.zh: 击球方式是什么。

sentences.en: What the stakes were from match to match.
sentences.zh: 每场比赛的赌注和意义是什么。

sentences.en: Who made them feel welcome in a sport that they just didn't necessarily feel drawn to in a lot of cases.
sentences.zh: 在许多情况下，人们原本对这项运动并不一定感兴趣，但她们却让人感到宾至如归。

sentences.en: And as a lifelong tennis fan, watching people in my family who typically would just leave me alone, walk over me while I'm lying on the floor watching tennis.
sentences.zh: 作为一个终身的网球迷，我看着家里平时根本不理我的人，从我躺在地板上看网球的身体上直接跨过去。

sentences.en: Stop and watch with me because they were playing.
sentences.zh: 因为她们在比赛，而停下来和我一起看。

sentences.en: Was huge.
sentences.zh: 这意义重大。

sentences.en: Huge.
sentences.zh: 意义重大。

sentences.en: And, you know, I compared her to Muhammad Ali earlier.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我刚才把她比作穆罕默德·阿里。

sentences.en: I don't make that comparison lightly.
sentences.zh: 我做出这个比喻并不是轻率的。

sentences.en: She had to be Black in public in a sport that just didn't know what to do with all that Blackness.
sentences.zh: 她必须在公众视野中展现黑人身份，而这项运动曾经根本不知道该如何面对这种浓厚的黑人特质。

sentences.en: And I feel like what we were watching in those three matches were the whole career just laid out for us.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们在那三场比赛中看到的，就是她整个职业生涯的缩影。

sentences.en: The fight.
sentences.zh: 那种战斗。

sentences.en: The proving wrong of doubters.
sentences.zh: 对所有怀疑者的有力回击。

sentences.en: The commitment to both herself and her legacy.
sentences.zh: 对她自己及其传奇地位的坚定承诺。

sentences.en: But mostly to the sport.
sentences.zh: 但最主要的是对这项运动的承诺。

sentences.en: To her vocation.
sentences.zh: 对她天职的承诺。

sentences.en: And there's no way you can tell me that this person who nobody, when she started playing this sport,
sentences.zh: 你绝不可能对我说，当她刚开始从事这项运动时，没有人认为她能坚持这么久，

sentences.en: thought would last as long as she did.
sentences.zh: 也没有人认为她能走得这么远。

sentences.en: Who had all of the odds stacked against her.
sentences.zh: 她面对着重重几乎不可能克服的困难。

sentences.en: Over and over and over again.
sentences.zh: 一次又一次，没完没了。

sentences.en: But there's no way you can tell me that that person brought all of that with her through three matches for the last tournament she was ever going to play.
sentences.zh: 但你绝对不能对我说，这样一个人在她职业生涯最后一场比赛的三场较量中，把所有这些都展现了出来，

sentences.en: And loSt.
sentences.zh: 并且输了比赛。

sentences.en: There's no way you can tell me that she didn't also win.
sentences.zh: 你绝不能对我说她同时没有赢得胜利。

sentences.en: Wesley, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 韦斯利，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Natalie, it was a pleasure.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，我的荣幸。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, the Russian military retreated from a key swath of territory in eastern Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 周末期间，俄军从乌克兰东部的一片关键领土撤退。

sentences.en: It is the biggest victory for Ukraine since its military drove the Russians out of the area around Kiev in March.
sentences.zh: 这是自今年三月乌军将俄军驱逐出基辅周边地区以来，乌克兰取得的最大胜利。

sentences.en: The conflict, now in its seventh month, had settled into a grinding war of attrition, with both sides defending their territory.
sentences.zh: 这场冲突目前已进入第七个月，演变成了一场艰苦的消耗战，双方都在极力捍卫自己的领土。

sentences.en: But late last week, Ukraine's army surged forward, eventually pushing the Russians out of the city of Izum, their key logistical hub in the eaSt.
sentences.zh: 但上周晚些时候，乌克兰军队发起猛攻，最终将俄军赶出了伊久姆市，那是他们在东部的关键后勤枢纽。

sentences.en: In order to achieve the stated goals of the special military operation to liberate Donbass, a decision was made to regroup the Russian troops stationed in Balaklir and Izum regions
sentences.zh: 为了实现解放顿巴斯的特别军事行动既定目标，有关方面决定对驻扎在巴拉克利亚和伊久姆地区的俄军进行重新集结，

sentences.en: to build up our efforts in the direction of Donetsk.
sentences.zh: 以便在顿涅茨克方向加强我们的力量。

sentences.en: The Russian defense ministry said it had pulled out of the area in a pre-planned move.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯国防部表示，其撤出该地区的行动是按计划预先安排好的。

sentences.en: But The Times reports that Russian military equipment left there suggest that the Russians had made a hasty retreat.
sentences.zh: 但《泰晤士报》报道称，遗留在当地的俄军装备表明俄军曾仓皇撤退。

sentences.en: Pro-Russian bloggers who comment on the war called it the most serious blow to Russian forces since the conflict began.
sentences.zh: 评论这场战争的亲俄博主称其为冲突爆发以来对俄军最沉重的打击。

sentences.en: Outside experts are now calling it a potential turning point in the war.
sentences.zh: 外部专家现在将其称为这场战争潜在的转折点。
